The corded power connector ensures a stable power source, and its low standby power consumption (0.6 W) helps save energy. Built to last, the scanner withstands drops from 1.5 meters (5 feet) and operates reliably in temperatures from 0–40 °C (32–104 °F). This Honeywell Voyager MK-9540 barcode scanner combines speed, accuracy, and durability, making it a smart choice for retail, inventory, and document management.

Kington Plus 7200T Pro Max Money Counting Machine

The Kington Plus 7200T Pro Max is an advanced money-counting machine designed for businesses that require accurate and efficient handling of large volumes of cash. This machine is equipped with advanced features to ensure the utmost reliability and security in currency processing. It boasts sophisticated fake note detection technologies, including ultraviolet (UV) and magnetic (MG) detection. UV detection utilizes ultraviolet light to highlight the security features embedded in genuine banknotes, making it easier to identify counterfeit notes. Meanwhile, MG detection senses the magnetic properties found in authentic currency, crucial for spotting fake notes that lack these properties. The machine performs real-time detection, automatically identifying and segregating counterfeit currency during counting. The Kington 7200T Pro Max features automatic error detection, including half-note and chained-note detection. This ensures that partial or torn notes and notes stuck together are flagged, preventing counting errors and maintaining accuracy. Its multi-currency capability allows it to handle most of the world's currencies, making it a versatile tool for international transactions. User convenience is further enhanced with a colorful digital monitor that provides clear and easy-to-read information, reducing operational errors. The machine includes three display panels: a primary display for the total count, a secondary display for batch counting details, and an external customer display that offers transparency and trust during transactions. Two operation keys simplify navigation and control of the machine’s features and settings. The Kington Plus 7200T Pro Max accommodates a range of note sizes, from a minimum of 50 x 110 mm to a maximum of 90 x 170 mm, and can handle note thicknesses between 0.075 mm and 0.15 mm. It features a 4-digit LCD counting display and a 3-digit LCD batch display, ensuring all essential information is visible. The machine's automatic start, stop, and clear functions streamline the counting process, reducing the need for manual intervention and enhancing efficiency. The Kington Plus 7200T Pro Max has the ability to detect fake Bangladeshi notes with 100% accuracy, addressing the unique challenges posed by their specific security features. The Kington Plus 7200T Pro Max is an indispensable tool for businesses, offering reliable counterfeit detection, user-friendly features, and versatile currency handling capabilities to ensure financial accuracy and operational efficiency.

Kington Plus AL 6700T Pro Max Money Counting Machine

The Kington Plus AL 6700T Pro Max is an advanced money counting machine tailored for efficient and reliable currency management. This machine is specifically designed to provide 100% accuracy in detecting counterfeit Bangladeshi notes, ensuring secure transactions. It is equipped with the latest sensors and a high-performance motherboard, which contribute to its superior accuracy and reliability. The Kington Plus AL 6700T Pro Max is compatible with multiple currencies from around the world, making it ideal for businesses that operate internationally. The machine boasts a vibrant digital monitor and three display screens: a primary display for the operator, a secondary display for additional information, and an extra customer display, ensuring transparency during transactions. For user convenience, it comes with two keyboards, allowing flexible and efficient operation. The machine also offers note value counting, which saves time and reduces errors by automatically calculating the total value of the notes counted. Automation is a key aspect of this model, with features such as automatic start, stop, and clear functions that streamline the counting process. The Plus AL 6700T Pro Max uses ultraviolet (UV) and magnetic (MG) detection to identify counterfeit notes and can automatically detect and separate half-notes and chained notes, preventing incomplete or improperly joined notes from being counted. Its infrared (IR) detection system ensures that double notes are accurately identified and separated. The machine includes batch counting, which allows for counting in pre-set quantities, and an add function that accumulates counts across multiple batches. A self-checking function ensures that the machine is in proper working order before use. The Kington Plus AL 6700T Pro Max is built to handle a variety of currencies, making it a versatile tool in diverse financial environments. The hopper of the machine can accommodate up to 100 old bills or 200 new bills, and the stacker has the same capacity, facilitating efficient and uninterrupted counting. With a counting speed of 1000 pieces per minute, this machine is ideal for high-volume cash handling situations, such as in banks and retail businesses. The Kington Plus AL 6700T Pro Max is a reliable, efficient, and secure money counting machine solution that meets the needs of businesses dealing with large volumes of cash and a variety of currencies. Its advanced features ensure the accuracy and security of financial transactions, making it an indispensable tool in any high-demand financial environment.

DINSTAR UC200 Pro IP PBX System

The DINSTAR UC200 Pro IP PBX System can handle up to 60 SIP users and 15 concurrent calls. It has two FXS and two FXO default analog ports and may be expanded to eight FXS or eight FXO ports with 2S, 2O, or 1S1O modules, with compatibility for up to three additional modules. Connectivity options for the DINSTAR UC200 Pro IP PBX System include two Gigabit Ethernet connections, one USB 2.0 connector, a TF card slot, and an RS232 console port. Voice features include codec support for G.711, G.729, G.726, OPUS, and G.722, as well as echo cancellation, AGC, fax support, NAT traversal, and VAD. It supports advanced call functions such call forwarding, transfer, parking, queueing, speed dialing, emergency calling, music on wait, call monitoring, auto-recording, and DISA. The DINSTAR UC200 Pro IP PBX System offers PBX services such as CDRs, voicemail to email, paging, auto-attendant, blacklist/whitelist, follow-me service, conference calls, WebRTC, Dinlink app compatibility, and advanced call routing capabilities. Security is prioritized with an IP firewall, Fail2ban, anti-brute-force methods, and dual-machine hot standby support. NTP, syslog, web-based management, network capture, and multi-language web portals enable automatic provisioning and firmware upgrades. The UC200 Pro also supports dynamic and static NAT and allows you to maintain your personal and company phonebooks via LDAP. With strong voice capabilities, smart PBX features, high scalability, and superior network security, the DINSTAR UC200 Pro IP PBX System stands out as a complete and future-proof communication hub for modern businesses that require dependable, flexible, and scalable voice solutions.

Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System

The Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System is a professional-level unified communication system. The Synway IP-PBX System's sophisticated design and flexible connectivity ensure smooth voice and video communication while maintaining great reliability and efficiency. The Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System includes two analog FXS ports that provide lifeline functionality during power outages and two FXO ports for PSTN line access, allowing for both digital and analog integration in a variety of communication contexts. Dual 10/100 RJ45 network interfaces with NAT router capabilities enable reliable data transmission and communication, while USB and TF connectors provide additional ease for data storage and system upgrades. The Synway IP-PBX System prioritizes performance, allowing for up to 50 simultaneous calls, even with SRTP encryption enabled. The Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System incorporates modern voice-over-packet technologies such as Line Echo Cancellation with a tail length of up to 128ms and a Dynamic Jitter Buffer to provide crystal clear audio. It supports a wide number of codecs for fax transmission, including G.711, G.722, G.729A/B, GSM, and T.38. The QoS function maintains consistent call quality across many network layers, making it a reliable solution for high-volume communication environments. The Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System boosts productivity with features including call park, call forwarding, DND, paging, ring groups, and intercom. It also contains a fully customized auto-attendant with limitless IVR layers and supports call center operations including automatic call distribution, skill-based routing, and in-queue announcements. The system may accommodate up to 25 conference participants at the same time over PSTN or IP lines. Security is strong, including SRTP, TLS, HTTPS, and advanced protection methods such as Fail2ban, whitelists, and blacklists to guard against network threats. Supporting multi-language interfaces and configurable IVR voice prompts, the Synway IP-PBX enables global versatility. The Synway UC200-30 IP-PBX System is a reliable, secure, and versatile solution for enterprises wishing to improve their communication infrastructure.

products.description:
Description

Grandstream GCC6010W Wireless WiFi 6 IP PBX System

The Grandstream GCC6010W Wireless WiFi 6 IP PBX System is a powerful, high-performance networking and telephony solution designed for small to medium-sized businesses. The Grandstream GCC6010W System supports the latest Wi-Fi 6 (IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax) standards, ensuring superior wireless connectivity across both 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequency bands. With three internal antennas (two dual-band and one single-band 5G), it delivers exceptional wireless performance, offering maximum gains of 4dBi (2.4GHz) and 6dBi (5GHz). The Grandstream GCC6010W Wireless IP PBX System provides impressive Wi-Fi data rates, reaching up to 573.5 Mbps on 2.4GHz and 3603 Mbps on 5GHz, enhanced by MU-MIMO technology (2x2:2 on 2.4GHz and 3x3:3 on 5GHz) for seamless multi-device connectivity. Security is a top priority in the Grandstream GCC6010W IP PBX System, featuring WPA/WPA2-PSK, WPA/WPA2 Enterprise (TKIP/AES), WPA3, anti-hacking secure boot, digital signatures, and unique security certificates per device. The Grandstream GCC6010W IP PBX includes five Gigabit Ethernet ports (configurable as WAN/LAN with up to three WAN connections), ensuring 1Gbps NAT throughput, 160K NAT sessions, and 900Mbps IDS/IPS. The system also supports 3Gbps IPsec VPN throughput with extensive VPN options, including IPsec, PPTP, L2TP, OpenVPN®, and WireGuard®, making it a secure and reliable solution for business communication. The Grandstream GCC6010W Wireless WiFi 6 IP PBX System offers built-in PBX functionality, supporting 12 users and four concurrent calls by default, with upgrade options for expanded capacity. Additional features include comprehensive QoS, firewall protection, content filtering, and application-based traffic control. This Grandstream GCC6010W IP PBX System is built for efficiency, operating within a temperature range of 0°C to 45°C, housed in a compact mini-tower design (95 x 95 x 193 mm) weighing 565g. Power efficiency is maintained with a universal power adapter (12VDC 1.5A, 18W). Ideal for businesses requiring scalability, the Grandstream GCC6010W Wireless IP PBX System supports up to 150 GWN APs and 500 clients, ensuring seamless connectivity. With Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS) integration, local Web GUI, SSH, and SNMP monitoring, the Grandstream GCC6010W System provides an advanced, reliable, and secure networking and telephony solution for modern business environments.

Businesses benefit from extensive application features such as multi-layered IVR for automated call routing, numerous call queues, automatic call distribution, and simultaneous conferencing for up to 25 people. The Synway UC200-45 IP-PBX System provides contact centers with intelligent queue management based on agent availability and skill level. The Synway IP-PBX prioritizes security by including SRTP, TLS, and HTTPS encryption protocols, as well as Fail2ban, whitelists, and blacklists to prevent unauthorized access. Description

Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX System

The Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX System is an advanced and scalable communication solution. The Synway IP-PBX supports up to 300 registered users and a maximum of 60 concurrent calls, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted communication in offices and contact centers. This Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX, housed in a desktop chassis, has dual 10/100 RJ45 network ports and a NAT router, allowing for greater network connectivity and flexibility. It has four FXO and two FXS built-in ports, as well as lifeline functionality, which allows it to provide analog phone service during power outages. The Synway IP-PBX offers high-quality audio with advanced voice-over-packet technology, carrier-grade line echo cancellation (32-128ms), LEC with NLP, and dynamic jitter buffer. The Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX System supports a variety of voice and fax codecs, including G.711, G.722, G.723.1, G.729A/B, GSM, and T.38 for fax over IP, ensuring wide interoperability. It also has useful call functions like call park, call forward, call transfer, DND, paging, ring group, and intercom, making it ideal for ordinary corporate communication. The Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX improves efficiency and customer service by providing comprehensive call center capabilities such as adjustable call queues and automatic call distribution. It can support up to 25-way conference bridges and an unlimited number of IVR layers for fully customisable auto attendants. Security is prioritized, with SRTP, TLS, HTTPS, Fail2ban, whitelist/blacklist, and alert systems in place to prevent unwanted access. Additionally, the Synway IP-PBX allows for simple deployment by TFTP, HTTP, or HTTPS, as well as a multilingual web interface in English, Chinese, and Traditional Chinese with customizable IVR prompts. The Synway UC200-60 IP-PBX System is an excellent solution for modern businesses due to its high performance, security, and flexibility.

products.description:
Description

Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System

The Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System provides seamless performance for enterprises that require enhanced voice and data integration. The Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System, designed to handle up to 300 registered users and 60 concurrent calls, offers the flexibility and efficiency required in modern office situations. With 2 FXO and 2 FXS connections, this Synway IP-PBX System offers dependable analog communication and ongoing operation even during power outages thanks to its lifeline functionality. Dual 10/100 RJ45 network ports and a built-in NAT router improve network management, while USB and TF connectors provide easy extension for storage or configuration. The Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System excels at voice-over-packet performance, with carrier-grade Line Echo Cancellation, dynamic jitter buffering, and sophisticated codec compatibility for high-quality audio and fax transmission, including G.711, G.722, G.729A/B, GSM, and T.38. It supports both DTMF and Pulse dial modes and allows for simple deployment over TFTP, HTTP, and HTTPS for auto-discovery and plug-and-play installation. This Synway IP-PBX is designed to increase productivity and efficiency in any organization with powerful call management features like as call park, call forwarding, transfer, DND, ring/hunt groups, and intercom paging. Network compatibility is extensive, including protocols such as TCP/IP, SIP, RTP, DNS, and TLS providing secure and stable connection. The Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System, which includes many layers of QoS, ensures stable speech quality even in high-traffic environments. The system also includes advanced call center features such as automatic call distribution, configurable IVR with limitless layers, and conference bridges for up to 25 people. Security is prioritized, with SRTP, HTTPS, and TLS encryption, as well as measures like Fail2ban and IP whitelisting. With multi-language web interface support and customized prompts, the Synway UC500-60 IP-PBX System provides dependability, scalability, and high performance, making it an ideal choice for enterprises looking for a secure, feature-rich Synway IP-PBX system.

With 2GB RAM, 32GB storage, and a 20,000-hour LED lifespan, this Android projector delivers long-term reliable value.

Native Full HD 1080P with 4K UHD Decoding

The Xiaomi Wanbo X7 Pro Max Smart Android Projector outputs native 1920 x 1080 Full HD resolution through LCD projection technology. 4K UHD video decoding supports H.265, H.264, and AV1 formats for the highest quality source files. A 2500:1 contrast ratio produces crisp detail separation between bright highlights and deep shadow areas. Image size scales from 40 to 180 inches across a projection distance of 1.2 to 5.0 meters.

Description

Canon ImageFormula DR-C340 Document Scanner

Office productivity depends on tools that keep up with real workloads. The Canon ImageFormula DR-C340 Document Scanner does exactly that. This Scanner scans documents, passports, ID cards, and business cards. It suits government offices, banks, insurance firms, and legal services alike. With duplex scanning at 40 pages per minute, this Canon ImageFormula Scanner moves fast. A 100-sheet ADF and compact design round out a genuinely practical office tool.

Scan Both Sides in a Single Pass

The Canon ImageFormula DR-C340 Document Scanner captures front and back simultaneously through single-pass duplex scanning. This cuts scanning time roughly in half compared to single-sided scanners. Simplex speed reaches 1.5 seconds per page across color, grayscale, and monochrome modes. Duplex speed improves further to 0.75 seconds per page for each side.

40 Pages Per Minute Scanning Speed

This high speed document scanner processes up to 40 pages per minute consistently. That translates to 80 images per minute when scanning both sides. This Canon office scanner handles daily volumes from 4,500 to 7,000 scans comfortably. Busy departments move through paperwork quickly without bottlenecking their workflow.

600 DPI Optical Resolution for Sharp Results

The Canon DR-C340 Document Scanner captures detail at 600 dpi optical resolution. Output resolution options range from 100 dpi up to 1200 dpi. This document scanner delivers 24-bit color depth alongside 8-bit grayscale internally. Text stays sharp and readable, even on documents with fine print or small fonts.

100-Sheet Automatic Document Feeder

This automatic document feeder scanner holds up to 100 sheets for continuous batch scanning. The retard roller separation method feeds pages reliably without jamming or misfeeds. This sheetfed scanner handles paper weights from 7.2 to 110 pounds smoothly. Long stacks of mixed documents scan through without requiring constant supervision.

Built for Passports, IDs, and Cards

The Canon DR-C340 Passport Scanner handles passports up to 6mm thick with a carrier sheet. It also scans plastic ID cards, including embossed cards, without damage. Business card scanning supports standard dimensions with accurate, clean digitization. This versatility suits banks, government offices, and rental services needing varied document types.

Long Document Mode for Extended Paper

This Canon scanner supports Long Document Mode for paper up to 240 inches long. That covers architectural drawings, extended forms, and unusually sized documents easily. This Canon DR-C340 professional document scanner adapts to standard paperwork and specialty formats alike. Few desktop scanners offer this level of flexibility for oversized documents.

Smart Features That Save Manual Work

The Canon ImageFormula DR-C340 includes ultrasonic double feed detection to catch misfed pages. Auto color detection and skip blank page features reduce unnecessary manual sorting. Barcode recognition, OCR, and auto page size detection streamline digital filing further. This business document scanner reduces the manual cleanup work that follows most scan jobs.

Simple Connectivity and Broad Compatibility

This Canon DR-C340 Scanner connects through USB-C, supporting USB 3.2 down to USB 2.0. It works with TWAIN and ISIS drivers across Windows and macOS systems. This desktop document scanner fits into most existing office IT environments without hassle. A monochrome LCD display keeps status and settings visible during daily operation.

Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System

The Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System delivers consistent performance for businesses that want improved voice and data integration. The Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System, which can handle up to 500 registered users and 100 concurrent calls, provides the flexibility and efficiency needed in modern office environments. With 2 FXO and 2 FXS connections, this Synway IP-PBX System provides dependable analog communication and continues to operate even during power outages thanks to its lifeline functionality. Dual 10/100 RJ45 network ports and a built-in NAT router make network management easier, while USB and TF connectors allow for simple storage or configuration extensions. The Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System excels at voice-over-packet performance, with carrier-grade Line Echo Cancellation, dynamic jitter buffering, and sophisticated codec support for high-quality audio and fax transmission, such as G.711, G.722, G.729A/B, GSM, and T.38. Network compatibility is comprehensive, including protocols such as TCP/IP, SIP, RTP, DNS, and TLS offering secure and robust connections. The Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System, which features many levels of QoS, maintains consistent speech quality even in high-traffic scenarios. The system also contains advanced call center features including intelligent call distribution, customized IVR with endless layers, and conference bridges for up to 25 users. Security is a top priority, with SRTP, HTTPS, and TLS encryption, as well as Fail2ban and IP whitelisting. With multi-language web interface support and customizable prompts, the Synway UC500-100 IP-PBX System offers dependability, scalability, and high performance, making it an excellent choice for businesses seeking a secure, feature-rich Synway IP-PBX system.

Grandstream GXW4224 Analog 24 FXS Port VoIP Gateway

The Grandstream GXW4224 VoIP Gateway has 24 FXS ports that accept both RJ11 and 50-pin Telco connectors. This gateway seamlessly integrates analog phones and fax machines into IP-based systems. The Grandstream GXW4224 Analog 24 FXS Port VoIP Gateway is designed to be fully compatible with major IP-PBXs, soft switches, and SIP-based systems, making it perfect for enterprises wishing to update their communications infrastructure while retaining old analog equipment.

To avoid fraud, the Tay-Chian TC-2000S Money Counting Machine uses UV detection technology to identify and sort counterfeit money quickly. It uses a power supply of either AC 110V at 60Hz or AC 220V at 50Hz and consumes 330W of power. It ensures a calmer working environment by producing less than 75 decibels.

Description

Optoma CinemaX D2 3000 Lumens 4K Ultra Short Throw DLP Laser Projector

The Optoma CinemaX D2 is a sleek ultra-short throw projector that provides an outstanding 4K UHD visual experience at home. The D2 is ideal for replicating the big-screen experience at home since it has a wide color gamut, great brightness, and superior DuraCore laser technology. With its enhanced gaming mode, the Optoma CinemaX D2 3000 Lumens 4K Ultra Short Throw DLP Laser Projector offers gamers low latency and blur-free images with a response time of 16 ms in 4K at 60Hz and 4 ms in 1080P at 240Hz, giving them a competitive edge over other projectors. The CinemaX's DuraCore laser light source produces brilliant, true color with a broad Rec.709 color gamut and a steady 3000-lumen brightness that is suitable for dimly lit to moderately lighted spaces. With its capacity to project a 100" image from less than one foot away and its flexibility to be adjusted to better match the color of your wall, the CinemaX is incredibly straightforward to set up. I occasionally saw rainbows when watching the video, which is a typical occurrence and cause for concern with DLP projectors.

True 4K UHD Visual Experience

With its 4K UHD resolution and support for eARC audio, the Optoma CinemaX D2 Ultra Short Throw Laser Projector offers a cinematic experience unlike any other. With the help of the extreme short-throw technology, you can view a 120-inch display from a mere few inches away. Up to 240Hz refresh rate at 1080P and 60Hz refresh rate at 4K UHD are supported in the enhanced gaming mode. Input lag is incredibly minimal, at only 4ms. CinemaX D2 sets up rapidly in almost any space thanks to its features, which include digital zoom, warping at 3*3 matrix, 4-corner adjustment, and 2D keystone correction. True 4K UHD resolution, HDR10 compatibility, pure glass optics, a laser light source, PureMotion picture processing, and superior sound come together in a slim form factor to produce an instant movie experience wherever.

4ms 240Hz Low Lag Gaming Mode

Experience 4K playback with the Optoma CinemaX D2 4K Ultra Short Throw DLP Laser Projector to get the best possible resolution from your games with a consistent 60 Hz frame rate and a low 16 ms latency. You can choose 1080p resolution at an incredibly fast 240 Hz refresh rate with a 4 ms low reaction time if speed and lag are your top concerns. The six-segment color wheel allows you to see brighter, more vibrant colors. The RGB color wheel reproduces games, TV shows, and movies in your home in the exact way that the filmmaker intended.

Full 3D Exprience

Support for 3D is another feature that the CinemaX D2 offers, which is a nice touch considering that projection is essentially the final frontier for 3D and is gradually becoming less common in projector features. Therefore, I'm happy to see it supported in new models wherever possible. The projector automatically enters 3D mode, which increases brightness, when it receives a 3D signal. When a regular set of 3D DLP-Link glasses linked immediately, there was very little to no crosstalk and a good sensation of depth in the image. Nine specific SDR, two 3D, and two HDR picture modes are available once this is unlocked. Cinema, Film, HDR SIM, Game, Reference, Bright, User, ISF Day, and ISF Night are among the SDR picture modes.

Easy Color Adjustments

The wide color gamut support's amazing color will elevate cinematic visuals to new heights. Vibrant, accurate, and lifelike colors are made possible with support for the large DCI-P3 color space. Make the most of your viewing environment by fine-tuning the Optoma CinemaX D2 Ultra Short Throw Laser Projector's color settings to display true and lifelike colors. By using the integrated geometric correction tool to alter individual points, you may achieve a picture that is precisely rectangular even on uneven surfaces.

Up to 120-inch Ultra Short Throw Projection

With a light source life of up to 30,000 hours, the Ultra Short Throw Laser technology produces exceptional brightness and retains breathtaking image quality over time. Any time of day, in a variety of settings, lights-on viewing for entertainment is made possible by the 3,000 lumens of brightness. With its ultra-short throw design and space-saving capabilities, the Optoma CinemaX D2 Ultra Short Throw Laser Projector offers ideal positioning for a large screen experience up to 120 inches from just inches away.

Description

HP LaserJet Enterprise MFP M528dn Multifunctional Mono Laser Printer 

The HP M528DN Multifunctional LaserJet Enterprise Printer is a business-oriented laser printer with great performance. It provides efficient black printing with a 1200 x 1200 dpi resolution, delivering sharp and clear text. Its duplex printing function allows it to print on both sides of the page instantly, saving time and decreasing paper waste. The printer is suitable with a variety of printing environments since it supports languages such as HP PCL 5, HP PCL 6, HP Postscript Level 3 (Emulation), and Native PDF. It offers a rapid print speed of 45 ppm for black documents and a duplex print speed of 34 ipm. The printer offers a short first print time of 6 seconds for black prints, allowing you to print your papers right away. It can handle high-volume printing demands with a monthly duty cycle of 150,000 pages and a suggested monthly volume of 7,500 pages. The HP M528DN is ideal for office locations where space is limited, with dimensions of 19 x 19.6 x 19.5" (W x H x D) and a weight of 47.18 lb. It combines high-quality printing, scanning, and copying capabilities with advanced functionality and reliability, making it an excellent choice for enterprises with high-volume printing requirements.

Efficient Printing with Duplex Capability

The HP M528DN provides bright and sharp black printouts with a print resolution of 1200 x 1200 dpi. Its quick printing speed of 45 ppm (black) allows for quick document generation, increasing job productivity. The printer also offers duplex printing, which allows for automated double-sided printing while conserving paper and money.

Wide Format Support and Large Paper Capacity

The HP M528DN has two input trays and one output tray for diverse media handling. It supports a broad range of media sizes, from 2.99 x 5" to a maximum of 8.5 x 14.02", and is capable of handling a wide range of document types. The printer has a large paper capacity, with 100 sheets in Input Tray 1, 550 pages in Input Tray 2, and up to 250 sheets in the output tray. It also accepts unique media, such as envelopes.

Flatbed Scanner with ADF and High Resolution

The HP M528DN scans documents efficiently due to its integrated flatbed scanner and automated document feeding (ADF). The scanner has a maximum optical resolution of 600 dpi, which ensures precise and detailed scans. It supports color and grayscale scanning modes, as well as a wide range of file formats such as JPEG, Multi-Page TIFF, PDF, PDF/A, TIFF, and XPS. The copier feature provides for simple duplicating, with choices for up to 9999 copies, duplex copying, and a color document copy quality of 600 x 600 dpi.

Seamless Connectivity and User-Friendly Interface

The HP M528DN provides seamless communication through RJ45 and USB-B connectors, making it simple to integrate into network infrastructures. It is compatible with a wide range of common operating systems, including Android, Windows, iOS, and macOS. The printer has an 8-inch touchscreen display with an easy-to-use interface for navigation and control.

Optimal Operating Conditions and Energy Efficiency

The temperature range for the HP M528DN is 42 to 65°F, with a suggested humidity range of 30 to 70%. It draws 629 W at full load but has energy-saving capabilities that reduce power consumption during standby and sleep modes. During operation, the printer produces a maximum acoustic noise level of 6.8 BA and 54 dBA under pressure.

Optoma ZU600UST-B 6000 Lumens Ultra Short Throw WUXGA Laser Projector

The Optoma ZU600UST-B is a professional Optoma projector that delivers 6000 lumens of brightness and sharp WUXGA (1920x1200) detail. Its DLP laser engine produces vivid images even in rooms with the lights on. The ultra short throw design creates a 100-inch image from just 28cm away, so you can save space and avoid shadows. The 300,000:1 contrast ratio, with 2,000,000:1 in dynamic mode, adds deep blacks and rich colors to every scene. You can also manage and monitor the projector through the cloud-based Optoma Management Suite. The package includes a security bar, and the projector suits meeting rooms, classrooms, exhibitions, museums, and retail spaces.

This Optoma ZU600UST-B ultra-short throw projector uses a DLP display with a native WUXGA resolution of 1920x1200. The high resolution keeps text crisp and documents easy to read, which reduces eye strain during long sessions. It supports 16:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios, so it fits both video and presentation content. The projection distance of 0.727m to 0.84m lets you place it close to the wall in tight rooms. This Optoma ZU600UST-B business laser projector uses the Optoma DuraCore laser light source instead of a traditional lamp. The laser lasts up to 30,000 hours in Eco mode, so you never need to replace a lamp. Instant on and off saves time between meetings and presentations. This Optoma ZU600UST-B commercial laser projector includes HDBaseT 3.0, which sends uncompressed video, audio, network, and control signals through a single cable over long distances. Canon imagePROGRAF GP-5300 36-inch Single Function Large Format Printer With Stand

The Canon imagePROGRAF GP-5300 is a cutting-edge 36-inch single-function large format printer built for professionals that need print precision and quality. This printer has great print-only capabilities and is intended to create spectacular color outputs, making it an ideal choice for a variety of applications. The GP-5300 provides efficiency without sacrificing quality, with a fantastic print speed of 1.3 pages per minute or 1 minute and 18 seconds, especially when generating posters, pictures, and fluorescent prints at A0 standard size. Color output from the printer is also remarkable, guaranteeing brilliant and accurate reproductions that satisfy the high requirements of professional graphics and design work. With a maximum paper size of A0, the Canon imagePROGRAF GP-5300 meets a wide range of requirements, including large-format projects. The built-in interface choices which include USB, LAN, and WiFi connectivity, increase its adaptability even more. These interfaces not only enable for smooth integration into existing networks, but also allow for wireless printing, letting users to their creativity without being tied to a certain spot. Furthermore, the printer comes with a strong stand that ensures stability during operation. The Canon imagePROGRAF GP-5300 is a dependable and high-performance large format printer that excels in both monochrome and color outputs. Its extensive capabilities, fast print rates, and flexible interface choices make it an excellent tool for professionals and enterprises with high-volume printing requirements.

Borderless Printing

Borderless printing is possible on all supported media in standard and bespoke widths. The imagePROGRAF GP-5300 printer can also print three-sided edge-to-edge on a variety of sizes that do not match the width of the roll paper. Because borderless print of varied sizes may be created from a single roll of media, this offers for greater flexibility in borderless printing tasks.

User Friendly Design and Operation

The sleek compact form with complete front-accessible options of imagePROGRAF GP-5300 printer allows for flush wall installation, taking up less office space. Files may be printed straight from the USB drive, and the built-in hard drive allows saved jobs to be reproduced without the need for a computer.

FINE Print Head

The completely integrated print head, which is equipped with micron-sized nozzles, provides excellent consistency of ink density and colors, while multi-pass printing guarantees that the best print quality is maintained on every print by imagePROGRAF GP-5300 printer.

Jabra PanaCast 55 AI-powered Videobar With Touch Controller

The Jabra PanaCast 55 Panoramic 4K Videobar With Touch Controller is an AI-driven videobar designed to transform modern meeting spaces. With its touch controller and panoramic multi-camera array, it delivers immersive video experiences. Supporting resolutions up to 4K, the device ensures crystal-clear visuals for professional presentations. The Jabra PanaCast 55 integrates smoothly with Microsoft Teams and Zoom, offering content sharing through Airplay, HDMI input, and Teams-Cast. Intelligent features like Virtual Director, Dynamic Composition, and Intelligent Zoom create a natural meeting flow. Enhanced with vivid HDR and multi-stream capabilities, this videobar ensures participants remain engaged. Its compact design, advanced sensors, and secure management options make it a powerful solution for hybrid work environments, ensuring smooth communication across diverse platforms.

Superior Camera Technology

Featuring a triple-camera setup, the Jabra PanaCast 55 supports panoramic video output at up to 3840 x 1080 resolution. Its 180° horizontal field of view captures every participant clearly. Intelligent Zoom and Intelligent Meeting Space adapt automatically, ensuring optimal framing. The advanced camera system also supports digital pan, tilt, and zoom, along with manual PTZ controls for flexibility. Virtual Director technology enhances meeting dynamics by focusing on active speakers. With vivid HDR and multi-stream composition, video quality remains sharp and lifelike. This Jabra PanaCast 55 system ensures professional-grade visuals for conference rooms of all sizes.

Exceptional Audio Performance

The Jabra PanaCast 55 delivers premium sound through four integrated speakers, including woofers and tweeters. Its audio coverage extends up to 7 meters, and with the PanaCast SpeakerMic, up to 11 meters. Automatic speaker detection and non-speech noise suppression ensure clarity. The Jabra PanaCast 55 uses an eight-microphone beamforming array, certified for rooms up to 4.5m x 6m. With echo cancellation and noise reduction, voices remain crisp and natural. This audio system guarantees professional communication, even in larger meeting spaces.

Secure Connectivity and Management

The Jabra PanaCast 55 offers extensive connectivity with Ethernet, HDMI, Wi-Fi, USB-A, and USB-C ports. It supports IPv4 and IPv6 protocols, ensuring reliable networking. Security features include authenticated access, secure boot, and vendor lock. The Jabra PanaCast 55 integrates with Jabra+, Web Console, and VaaS Admin Portals for remote management. Compatible with Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms, it provides seamless device control. With advanced sensors for temperature, humidity, and CO2, it enhances workplace monitoring. This durable system ensures secure, efficient, and professional collaboration across platforms.

Logitech Rally Bar 4K Video Conferencing Camera

The Logitech Rally Bar 4K Video Conferencing Camera is a powerful all in one solution designed for professional meeting spaces. Featuring a PTZ camera, 6 beamforming microphones, dual speakers, AI Viewfinder, and integrated cable management, this Logitech Video Conferencing Camera delivers seamless video and audio performance. Built on Logitech CollabOS, it ensures compatibility with leading conferencing platforms, making it ideal for hybrid work environments and enterprise collaboration.

Ultra HD Video and Intelligent Framing

Equipped with a 4K camera supporting multiple resolutions including 1440p, 1080p, 900p, 720p, and SD at 30fps, the Logitech Rally Bar captures every detail with precision. Its motorized pan 25 degrees, tilt 15 degrees, and 15X HD zoom 5X optical plus 3X digital provide flexible coverage for medium to large rooms. With a 90 degree diagonal field of view and AI powered RightSight technology, this Logitech Video Conferencing Camera automatically frames active speakers while ensuring all participants remain visible, creating equitable meeting experiences.

Immersive Audio Performance

The Logitech Rally Bar 4K integrates dual 70mm drivers with patented suspension to eliminate vibration induced interference. Delivering up to 99dB SPL at 8W with a 48kHz sampling rate, it ensures rich, room filling sound. Six omnidirectional MEMS microphones form adaptive acoustic beams with a pickup range of up to 7 meters, supported by advanced audio processing including acoustic echo cancellation, voice activity detection, and AI based noise suppression. For larger spaces, the Rally Bar supports up to 4 additional Rally Mic Pods and 2 Mic Pod Hubs, making it a scalable Logitech Video Conferencing Camera solution.

Smart Features with RightSense Technologies

Logitech RightSense suite enhances conferencing with RightLight for natural skin tones, RightSight for intelligent framing, and RightSound for voice clarity. Grid View ensures all participants are equally represented, while AI denoising suppresses background distractions. These intelligent features make the Logitech Rally Bar 4K Video Conferencing Camera a professional grade tool for hybrid meetings and enterprise collaboration.

Connectivity and Secure Management

The Rally Bar supports dual HDMI outputs up to 1080p, HDMI input, multiple USB ports Type A and Type C, Ethernet, and WiFi 802.11ac. It integrates seamlessly with Logitech Sync for centralized device management, offering secure access with AES 128 encryption, PKI, and Arm TrustZone protection. With support for IPv4, IPv6, and proxy configurations, this Logitech Video Conferencing Camera ensures enterprise grade connectivity and security.

Flexible Mounting and Accessories

Designed for versatility, the Logitech Rally Bar can be mounted on walls, TVs, or placed on a table stand. Accessories such as Rally Mic Pods, Mic Pod Hubs, and Logitech Tap controllers expand functionality, while Logitech Strong USB cables 10m, 25m, 45m provide reliable connectivity for larger spaces. Its all in one enclosure ensures easy installation and minimal clutter, making it a complete Logitech Video Conferencing Camera solution.

The Logitech Rally Bar 4K Video Conferencing Camera combines ultra HD video, immersive audio, AI driven intelligence, and enterprise grade security in one device. Perfect for medium to large meeting rooms, it delivers professional quality collaboration experiences with simplicity, scalability, and reliability.

Maxhub E9830 98" 4K UHD Interactive Flat Panel

products.description:
Description

Grandstream HA100 IP PABX Server

The HA100 is ideal for any business that requires an always-on, redundant voice system by providing an automatic failover solution when paired with two UCM6510 IP PBXs. The device will constantly monitor the operational status of both UCM6510s and will automatically switch all system control to the hot-standby secondary UCM6510 when the primary device fails for any reason. The HA100 offers an automated failover solution for the UCM6510 IP PBX. When connecting between two UCM6510, the HA100 constantly monitors the operation status of both UCM6510 and automatically switches the system control (including all of the connected telecom lines, network links, auxiliary devices, and all of the SIP endpoints previously registered on the primary UCM6510) to the hot-standby secondary UCM6510 in the event that the primary UCM6510 fails. It can complete the entire system switch between 10 and 50 seconds depending on the number of registered SIP endpoints. Thanks to its smart monitoring and automated failover capability, the HA100 is an ideal high-availability solution for the UCM6510 to ensure maximum total system reliability and uptime.

The Fujitsu FI-8170 Image Scanner also has advanced features such as automatic color detection, blank page detection, hole punch removal, image emphasis, front back merging, and more, that enhance the scanning quality and efficiency.

Scanning Speed and Resolution

The scanner has a scanning speed of 70 ppm (pages per minute) for simplex scanning and 140 ipm (images per minute) for duplex scanning. Image Sensor and Light Source

The Sunmi M2 Max is a smart 10.1-inch Enterprise POS Tablet that is particularly built for companies, providing a balance of performance, durability, and adaptability. Its core features a powerful Kryo-260 octa-core CPU clocked at 2.2GHz, allowing for flawless multitasking. The M2 Max POS tablet's display is a notable feature, with a sharp Full HD resolution of 1920 x 1200 pixels on its 10.1-inch screen. The touch screen capability is snappy and user-friendly, which improves the entire user experience while entering data or engaging with programs. The Sunmi M2 Max's camera arrangement will appeal to both amateur and professional photographers. It has a 5MP front-facing camera for video conferencing and selfies, and a 13MP back camera with flash for taking high-quality photos and movies. The Sunmi M2 Max also has NFC (Near Field Communication) technology, which enables contactless transactions and data sharing, making it perfect for point-of-sale applications. The audio features include a 3.5mm earphone connector and built-in speakers with 1W output for clear and immersive music. The M2 Max POS tablet runs SUNMI OS, which is based on Android 9.0, and has a familiar and easy user interface. It is designed for corporate applications and has pre-installed software targeted to enterprise requirements. The M2 Max tablet is powered by a high-capacity 8360mAh non-removable LiPo battery that provides up to 12 hours of backup time, allowing it to last the entire workday on one charge. A PSAM card slot for secure transactions, an IP65 protection certification against dust and water intrusion, and a 1.0m drop specification provide durability and resilience in harsh settings. The tablet also supports a variety of card types, including Type A and B, Mifare, and Felica cards that comply with ISO/ICE 14443 and ISO15693 standards. The Sunmi M2 Max is a comprehensive solution for organizations searching for a dependable and adaptable POS tablet that can suit a variety of requirements.

Description

Avision AD250F Flatbed with ADF Scanner

The Avision AD250F Enhanced with innovative features, the Avision AD250F offers high throughput of 80 ppm and 160 ppm in a compact footprint conserving both space and budget. Unlike common sheet-fed scanners which provide only the auto document feeder and can not accommodate irregular sizes and weights of paper, the AD250F harmoniously combines the benefits of the fast scan rate of the ADF and the convenience of the flatbed unit to meet customer’s diverse requirements.

Support form document up to 242 x 356 mm (9.5 x 14 in.)

The AD250F has a distinct and innovative design in comparison to its predecessors, with the ability to accommodate form documents up to 242 x 356 mm (9.5 x 14 in.). The increased document width of the AD250F from 216 mm (8.5 in.) to 242 mm (9.5 in.) makes it more competitive in terms of accommodating a wider range of documents.

Reverse Roller Enhances Feeding Reliability & Paper Protection Technology

The AD250F delivers outstanding feeding reliability and operating productivity by effectively reducing the risk of a multi-feed or paper jam, thanks to its innovative reverse roller for advanced paper separation capability. The advanced Paper protection technology protects valuable paper from being wrinkled or torn by halting the scan process once a skewed page is detected.

A Duplex Scanner Suited for Document and Cards

The AD250F Mixed batches of documents of various sizes and weights can be scanned, cropped, deskewed, and ready to use thanks to advanced straight paper path and image processing technology. Scan size ranges from 50 x 50 mm (2 x 2 in.) receipts to 242 x 356 mm business documents (9.5 x 14 in.). The auto document feeder is also strong enough to feed paper up to 400 g/m2 (110 lb.) and embossed hard cards up to 1.4 mm in thickness, such as ID cards, credit cards, driver's licenses, and health insurance cards.

Automatic multiple image cropping

Furthermore, the scanner includes the useful feature of multiple image cropping. With this feature, you can place various sizes of documents on the flatbed, such as photos, ID cards, or business cards, and the scanner will crop and create multiple images based on the original sizes of the documents in a single scan.

Earth-Friendly LED Technology

The AD250F has a high throughput and excellent performance. It is, however, environmentally friendly. LED technology requires no warm-up time and consumes less power without emitting mercury vapor than traditional scanners that use CCFL (cold cathode fluorescent lamp) technology.

High-Volume Daily Duty Cycle

The scanner can scan up to 11,000 pages per day using the 100-page automatic document feeder. According to the data, this scanner is intended to scan documents in any application requiring frequent document and hard card scanning.

Powerful bundled software applications

The AD250F includes TWAIN and ISIS drivers as well as a suite of powerful software applications such as Avision Button Manager, AVScan, and PaperPort. With the press of a button, you can scan to searchable PDF, JPEG, BMP, or GIF file format, save to a folder on your computer, and scan to e-mail, image editing software, or even a cloud application such as Google Drive or Microsoft SharePoint. The AVScan and PaperPort are powerful image processing and document management applications that can help you streamline your workflow. The Avision AD250F Flatbed with ADF Scanner comes with a 01-year warranty.

Description

Optoma L1 Plus 2500 lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector is a cutting-edge device designed to transform your home entertainment experience. With its 4K UHD resolution (3840x2160) and 2500 lumens of brightness, this ultra short throw projector delivers incredibly sharp images, rich details, and vibrant colors, making it perfect for home cinema enthusiasts. The ultra short throw lens allows for a large screen projection from a very short distance, ideal for small spaces and eliminating shadows. Supporting multiple aspect ratios, including 16:9, and offering a screen size range from 80 inches to 130 inches diagonal, it adapts to various viewing needs. The impressive contrast ratio of 1,800,000:1 provides deep blacks and brilliant whites, enhancing the overall visual experience. Utilizing advanced 4LED technology, the Optoma L1 Plus ensures high-quality projections and a long lifespan of up to 30,000 hours, providing reliable and maintenance-free operation. Connectivity is seamless with three HDMI inputs, a USB-A power output, and a 3.5mm audio output, allowing easy connection of various devices. The built-in 10W speaker provides adequate audio output, and the included Android TV dongle enables access to popular streaming apps like Netflix. Designed for convenience and versatility, the Optoma L1 Plus supports 360° installation and is perfect for 24/7 operation, making it a versatile choice for any home entertainment setup.

Stunning 4K UHD Resolution

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector features an impressive 4K UHD resolution (3840x2160), which is four times the resolution of Full HD (1080p). This high pixel density results in incredibly sharp images, rich details, and vibrant colors, making it perfect for home cinema enthusiasts. The 4K UHD resolution ensures that every scene is displayed with stunning clarity and precision, enhancing the overall viewing experience. Whether you're watching movies, playing games, or streaming content, the 4K UHD resolution of the Optoma L1 Plus provides a more immersive and lifelike visual experience, bringing your favorite content to life with exceptional detail and realism.

Enhanced Gaming Mode

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector features an Enhanced Gaming Mode designed to elevate your gaming experience. This mode optimizes the projector's performance by reducing input lag and increasing response time, ensuring smoother gameplay and more precise control. With Enhanced Gaming Mode, you can enjoy faster frame rates and a more immersive gaming experience, making it perfect for both casual and competitive gamers. Whether you're playing fast-paced action games or exploring detailed open worlds, this feature ensures that your gaming sessions are seamless and highly responsive.

Smooth Motion with VRR Compatibility

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector features Smooth Motion technology with Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) compatibility, ensuring an exceptional gaming and viewing experience. VRR dynamically adjusts the projector's refresh rate to match the frame rate of your content, eliminating screen tearing and stuttering. This results in fluid and seamless visuals, especially during fast-paced action scenes or gaming sessions. By reducing input lag and enhancing response times, VRR compatibility ensures that every movement is displayed with precision, providing a more immersive and enjoyable experience for gamers and movie enthusiasts alike.

HDR and HLG Compatibilit

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector is HDR and HLG compatible, enhancing your viewing experience with superior color and contrast. High Dynamic Range (HDR) technology provides a wider range of colors and greater contrast, resulting in more realistic and vibrant images. Hybrid Log Gamma (HLG) is particularly beneficial for broadcast content, as it combines standard dynamic range (SDR) and HDR into a single signal, ensuring compatibility with both older and newer displays. This means you can enjoy enhanced picture quality with deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and more vivid colors, whether you're watching movies, TV shows, or live broadcasts. The combination of HDR and HLG compatibility ensures that the Optoma L1 Plus delivers an immersive and lifelike visual experience, making it an excellent choice for home cinema enthusiasts.

Precise Geometric and Four Corner Correction

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector features advanced geometric and four corner correction capabilities, ensuring a perfectly aligned and distortion-free image. These features allow you to easily adjust the projection to fit any screen or surface, even in challenging setups. Geometric correction helps to correct any image distortion caused by the projector's angle or placement, while four corner correction allows you to fine-tune each corner of the image independently. This ensures that your visuals are always sharp, clear, and perfectly aligned, providing an optimal viewing experience regardless of the projection environment. Whether you're setting up in a home theater, living room, or any other space, these correction features make installation and adjustment straightforward and hassle-free.

Eye Protection Sensor

The Optoma L1 Plus 2500 Lumens Ultra Short Throw 4K LED Home Projector features an advanced eye protection sensor designed to enhance user safety and comfort. This sensor detects when someone is too close to the projector beam and automatically reduces the brightness to prevent eye strain and potential damage. Description

Deli ET903 Money Counting Machine

The Deli ET903 Money Counting Machine counts at 1000 notes per minute, so busy shops and offices finish large cash piles in minutes. Three authentication methods check every note with infrared, ultraviolet, and fluorescence detection, which helps you spot fake currency before it enters your till. Four counting modes, UV, CNT, BATCH, and ADD, let you match the machine to each cash task. This Deli money counter supports multiple currencies, so one device handles different notes without extra equipment. Its dual screen shows the count clearly to both the operator and the customer, which builds trust at the counter. A compact body fits easily on a desk or shop counter. Deli packs this business cash counter with everything it needs for daily use, and it suits shops, banks, offices, and wholesale counters.

The Deli ET903 cash counting machine starts each day with an automatic sensor check at startup, which confirms the machine is ready before you load any notes. The input tray holds up to 130 notes, so you can load a full stack and let the machine work without constant refilling. The output tray also holds up to 130 notes, which keeps counted cash neat and stops the stack from spilling. Entry and exit sensing tracks each note as it moves through the machine, so the final count stays accurate and jams are easy to notice. The powerful motor drives the rollers at a steady pace, which keeps the speed high even during long counting sessions. In CNT mode the machine simply counts every note, while BATCH mode stops at a set number so you can prepare fixed bundles quickly. ADD mode keeps a running total across several stacks, which saves you from writing figures by hand. UV mode adds authentication to the count, so you verify and count in a single pass. The infrared check looks at the ink and print features of each note, while the ultraviolet and fluorescence checks reveal hidden marks that fake notes often miss. This automatic bill counter weighs only 2.8 kg, so you can carry it between counters or store it after closing. Rhe  Deli ET903 is a reliable banknote counting machine for any shop or office, even where the power supply varies.

Optoma ZW521 6000 Lumens WXGA Laser Business Projector

The Optoma ZW521 is a 6000 lumens laser projector built for bright rooms and busy workplaces. Its DLP display delivers WXGA 1280x800 images with sharp detail and vivid color. The DuraCore laser light source runs up to 30,000 hours in Eco mode, so you never replace a lamp. The high contrast ratio of 2,000,000:1 gives deep blacks and clear text on every slide. You can connect it through HDMI, VGA, USB-A, and RJ45, and manage it from one place with Optoma Management Suite. The projector also supports 3D content, which adds value for training and simulation setups. It ships with a security bar, a Kensington lock slot, and a password-protected interface to keep the projector safe. It is a smart choice for meeting rooms, classrooms, and commercial spaces.

6000 Lumens Laser Projector for Bright Rooms

This Optoma ZW521 projector produces 6,000 lumens of brightness, so visuals stay sharp and readable even with the lights on. The DuraCore laser engine keeps brightness and color steady across 30,000 hours of Eco mode use. Instant on and off lets you start a presentation in seconds and shut down without waiting. Lower power use and zero lamp replacements reduce your total cost of ownership over the years. The WXGA resolution of 1280x800 supports 4:3 and 16:9 aspect ratios, which suit both older and modern content. Its quiet 29 dB(A) operation keeps classrooms and boardrooms calm during long sessions.

WXGA Business Projector with Flexible HDMI Connectivity

The Optoma ZW521 WXGA projector gives you two HDMI 1.4 inputs, one VGA input, and a 3.5mm audio input for quick laptop and player setup. Two USB-A 2.0 outputs, a 3D sync output, and a 3.5mm audio output let you power accessories and send sound to speakers. RJ45, RS232, and a 12V trigger give control options for fixed installations and automated screens. The projector works with PC signals from VGA up to WUXGA and 1080p, so most devices connect without trouble. It also handles NTSC, PAL, SECAM, SDTV, HDTV, and UHD video sources. A projection distance of 1m to 10m with mechanical travel, and 1m to 5m with optical travel, helps you fit it into rooms of different sizes.

Laser Projector for Business with Network Management

This Optoma ZW521 commercial laser projector works with Optoma Management Suite, a cloud-based or local network tool for monitoring and control. You can check device status, run diagnostics, and adjust settings from anywhere through a single platform. The 24/7 real-time monitoring helps IT teams fix problems early and keep every display running well. The DLP technology keeps images precise over the long term, which suits schools and offices. Support for HDMI 1.4a 3D formats, including frame pack, side-by-side, and top-bottom, adds flexibility for training and simulation.
